text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Finding themselves somehow stranded on an unknown beach,
{0}, Tamaki and Mifuyu have decided to split up
and explore the immediate vicinity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とタマキ、ミフユは手分けして
いつの間にか打ち上げられていた島の浜辺付近の探索をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Any luck, Tamaki? Did you find any signs of life?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう、
タマキさん？
　そっちの方角には誰かいた？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I did! I found a whole bunch of cats!
Big kitties, little kitties, stripy kitties and spotty kitties...
And they were so eager to play with me! It was adorable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがなんと、
猫がいっぱいいたにゃ～！
　
おっきい子、
ちっちゃい子、
しましまやぶちやまだら模様の子たち……
あたしに必死でじゃれついてきたのにゃ。
可愛かったにゃあ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, that certainly sounds like good news...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
猫がたくさんいてよかったわね……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wait, no it doesn't! Is this the time to be playing with cats?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
よくないわよ！
　猫と遊んでる場合じゃないでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I... I did keep my eyes peeled for people, too!
But as far as I could tell, there was nyobody to be seen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃ、
ちゃ～んと人がいるかも調べたにゃ！
でも調べた範囲じゃ
人の姿はどこにもなかったにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, that matches my experience, too.
I saw a few small animals like dogs, but no sign of human life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
こっちも似たような成果だったわ。
犬とかの小動物ばかりで、
人の気配は感じない……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
How about you, {0}?
From that forlorn-looking face, I suppose you had no luck either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは……？
その浮かない顔を見ると
結果は同じだったみたいね……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Nyow I'm starting to feel pretty hungry, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
それよりなんだかお腹が空いてきたにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Good point. I don't know the exact time of day, but it must be
close to dinnertime. Since we lost our boat along the way,
we don't have any fish... What should we do for food tonight...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに。
正確な時間はわからないけど、
そろそろ夕飯時かしら。
船ごとどこかに行っちゃったから、
釣った魚もないし……
今日の夕飯、
どうしましょう……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I think I just saw a big fish out there in the sea!
{0}, Tamaki, let's work together
and see if we can catch it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ……
今そこの海に大きな魚の影が見えたわ！
{0}くん、
タマキさん、
連係プレイで
捕まえるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
{0}, get into the water and chase the fish this way.
Then I'll flip it out of the water with my spear,
and Tamaki, you catch it when I do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは海に入って、
魚を私の方に追い込んで。
そしたら私が槍で魚を打ち上げるから、
最後にタマキさんがキャッチして！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
C'mon, {0}, chase that fish our way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったにゃ！
さあ、
{0}、
魚をミフユの方に追い込むにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
That's right, {0}! You're doing great!
Keep it up like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、{0}くん、うまいわね！
その調子よ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to grab the fish yourself!
Just chase it in my direction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは捕まえようとしなくていいの！
私の方に追い込んで！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Here goes! Tamaki, get ready to catch the fish once I flip it!
Hyaaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来たわっ！
　タマキさん、
魚を打ち上げるからキャッチして！
それーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm on it!
Caaaaaaaatch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せるにゃーーーっ！
キャーーーーーーッチ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: The fishie is miiiiiiine!
text_block_list.orig_text: 獲ったにゃーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work! Let's cook it and dig in right away!
I'll rub some sticks together to make a fire!
I didn't do all sorts of part-time work for nothing! Hyaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったわね！
　さっそく焼いて食べましょう！
私が枝木をこすって火を起こすから！
だてに色んなバイトを経験してないわよ！
　うりゃーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That was delicious...
I feel like the cat that got the cream!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
美味しかったにゃ～……
お腹いっぱいになったにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... You know, the three of us
might be pretty well suited to the castaway life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
私たちって、
結構サバイバル能力あるのかもね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Don't you think these fluffy grass piles
look like the purr-fect sleeping bags?!
Let's rest up here for tonight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
たまたまここに
寝袋みたいになってるふかふかの草があるにゃ！
今晩はここで夜を明かすにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Good call. We've all worked pretty hard today...
It's time we gave our bodies a rest.
Good night, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
今日はたくさん体を動かしたし……
いったん休息しましょう。
お休みなさーい……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Morning's here!
text_block_list.orig_text: 朝にゃーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
These grass bags were even comfier than I expected!
Now then... If we could just find some way to get off the island,
I'd have no complaints...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この草、
なんだか想像以上に快適だったわね！
あとは……
この島から脱出するための
ものが見つかれば
最高なんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes—there was an area I didn't get to explore yesterday.
I tried to go there, but there were monsters prowling around,
so I decided it wasn't efficient.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
昨日調べてなかった地域がまだあるんだけど……
なんでかって言うと、
魔物が何匹かうろついていて
効率が悪そうだったのよね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's wake ourselves up properly
by sharpening our claws on some monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
眠気覚ましも兼ねて
みんなで行って退治するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's a fine idea!
This way, everyone. Follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
そうしましょう！
みんな、こっちよ、
ついてきて！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
As I thought... Those monsters are still around.
Let's teach them a little lesson!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり……
あそこに魔物たちがいるわ。
ちゃちゃっと蹴散らしちゃいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRRAAAAGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahah! You're nyot gonna scare us like that! Hip-huppety hop!
Kitty... Cat-aclysm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはっ、
そんなんじゃ威嚇にもならないにゃ。
ほいっ
ほいっ
とにゃ♪
ねこねこ……
ファイナルブレーーーイク！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was easier than I expected...
Could it be these monsters are incredibly weak?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
思ってたよりあっさり倒せたわね。
もしかしてここの魔物……
すごく弱い？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, all the better. Time to explore the area.
Let's see, what's over this way... Oh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
いいわ。
付近を調べてみましょう。
さて、
こっちには何が……
あら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Look! There's a raft lying on the shore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て！
　いかだが漂着してるわ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: You're right! D'you think we can use it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントにゃ！
　使えそうかにゃ～？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The logs are tied together firmly...
I can't see any problems. Let's head out to sea on this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
丸太もしっかり結んであるし……
特に問題はなさそうよ。
これで海に出ましょう！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: All righty! To the open seas we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーーっし！
　さっそく出発にゃーーー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... With these winds, the raft's just sailing along!
I guess that's it for our desert island life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
風に乗ってぐんぐんいかだが進むにゃ……
無人島ともこれでおさらばにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
While we don't know the island's exact location,
I expect if we head north, we should be able to reach the Marjan Coast.
It's a good thing I took on a navigating job once upon a time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの島の正確な位置はわからないけど、
たぶんおおまかに
北の方に行けばマルジェン海岸に辿り着くはずよ。
昔、航海士のバイトをした経験があって良かったわ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
For a while there, I was really worried...
But in this gentle wind, I'm sure we'll be fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一時はどうなることかと思ったけど……
風は穏やかだし、
もう大丈夫ね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Whew... Such a relief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
よかったにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'm feeling so relieved, it's actually making me drowsy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね……
安心したら、
なんだか眠くなってきたわ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's all this comfy sunlight's fault
that we wound up stranded there in the first place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいたい、
漂流したのだって、
この気持ち良い陽気がいけないんだにゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: It really is so warm... and comforting...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと、
あったかくて……
いい気持ち……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Unnhhh... Myaaaaagh?!
We're back at the beach where we started?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん…………
にゃーーーーーーっ！？
また砂浜に漂着してるにゃーーーーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! Wh-what happened to our raft?!
{0}, wake up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれっ！？
　い、
いかだはどこにいったの！？
{0}くんも起きて！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I let my guard down...
Why did I let myself fall asleep again...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
不覚だわ……
どうしてまた寝てしまったのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we should nyever have trusted a raft like that!
We need a proper boat that's not going to sink!
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか、
あんな小さないかだじゃ駄目だったんだにゃ！
沈没しないように
もっと大きな船じゃにゃいと……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You're right... But we were lucky to even find a raft.
We're hardly going to just stumble across an actual...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね……
でも、いかだだってやっと見つかったんだし、
そうそう都合よく船なんて見つかるわけ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh! There's a boat lying over there on the beach!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーーーっ！
　あそこに小型船が漂着してるにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: No way?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 嘘っ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It's true...
There's a small boat, and it's in fully working order...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとだわ……
また、
どこも壊れてなさそうな小型船がある……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get back to Landosol right now!
Mifuyu! {0}! Let's try this one more time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一刻も早くランドソルに帰りたいにゃ！
ミフユ！
　{0}！
　すぐ出発するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
A-all right! This time, let's be careful to stay awake...
OK, we'll set off at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうね！
　今度は寝ないように気を付けて……
……よしっ、
行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... The wind feels so good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
風がいい気持ちにゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This boat is much sturdier than that raft,
so I'm sure it can handle the waves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この船ならさっきより丈夫だし、
波にも引っ張られないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Still, we certainly did luck out, didn't we?
This time, I'm sure we'll be fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
本当にラッキーだったわね、
私たち！
今度こそ、
きっと大丈夫ね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Thank goodness... We're finally safe... Myahhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふあぁ……
よかった……
これで大丈夫……
にゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myagh! Nothing's safe about this at all!
We're back where we started again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
ちっとも大丈夫じゃないにゃ～！
また、漂着してるにゃーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! The boat's gone too...
Are you telling me I fell asleep after all that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれっ！？
　船がまた消えて……
っていうか私、
また寝ちゃってた！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, Mifuyu?! Again?!
You should be more responsible as our captain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユは寝すぎにゃ！
　もっとちゃんと船長の自覚を持つにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I think you'll find you fell asleep before I did!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうタマキさんの方が
先に寝てたじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I'm a cat! Sleeping's what we do!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしは猫だから仕方ないのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But what are we going to do nyow...?
If even that boat's nyo good, we might need a full-on ship...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ほんとどうしようかにゃ……
小型船でダメなら、
大型船を用意しにゃいと……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: We'd need a real miracle to just stumble across...
text_block_list.orig_text: いくらなんでもそんなに都合よく……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Mifuyu! There's a gigantic cruise ship,
the kind with luxury rooms and a pool and entertainment,
washed up on the beach over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ミフユ！
　
今度はあそこに超大型で
一等船室やプールやビリヤード室まで付いてそうな
豪華客船が漂着してるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You have [i]got[/i] to be kidding me, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text: いくらなんでも嘘でしょーーーーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I think fate's rewarding me for all my good deeds!
We've got to try this one out, right?!
If we don't get home, everyone'll be worried sick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
きっとあたしの日頃の行いがいいからに違いないにゃ。
とにかく試してみるしかないにゃ！
早く帰らないと、
みんなが心配するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I suppose... Since it's such a huge ship, and so sturdily built...
All right, then. Let's set sail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でもそうね、
さすがにこの大型客船なら……
よし、
行くわよっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myahoooo! So huge! So fast! This is the best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっほーっ！
　でかいにゃ！
　速いにゃ！
　快適にゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: If this ship can't get us back home, I'm pretty sure nyothing will!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この大型客船でダメなら、
もうどうしようもないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yes... We could hardly ask for a... more... certain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ……
これでもダメだったら……
どう……
しようも……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It's the... perfect...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしようも……
ふにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myaaarghhhhh!
Even the ship was nyo good?! We're back here yet again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃーーーーーーっ！
あれでもダメだったにゃ！
　また戻ってきちゃってるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wh-what can all of this possibly mean...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは一体、
どういうことなの……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Finding that all attempts to leave the island ended in failure,
the three castaways were completely at a loss for words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう脱出を試みても必ず島に戻ってしまい、
３人は途方に暮れるのであった。
